integrity: The proof uses the previously published exact mean-first-passage expression with attribution; numerical root checks are separate corroboration. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite reflecting interval, independent Poisson resets to the initial position, no capture/refractory delay, and fixed positive diffusion, length and per-server service rate; server count tends to infinity. No finite-server uniqueness assertion or independent mathematical audit.
title: A logarithmically enhanced crossover rate for finite-server queues supplied by a resetting searcher
